messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 3 messages:

[2025-09-04T07:30:00Z] customer (Katharina Müller): Meine Bestellung HH-30417 ist immer noch nicht in Wien angekommen. Seit 9 Tagen keine Bewegung.
[2025-09-04T10:15:00Z] agent (Dana (HelpHub)): Guten Tag Frau Müller, ich habe eine Nachforschung beim Paketdienst eingeleitet und melde mich bis Freitag.
[2025-09-05T16:05:00Z] customer (Katharina Müller): Danke. Falls es bis nächste Woche nicht da ist, möchte ich das Geld (62,90 €) zurück.

message.content:
Issue: Order HH-30417 has not arrived in Vienna after 9 days with no tracking updates.  
Tried so far: Agent initiated a carrier inquiry and committed to follow up by Friday.  
Next step: If the order is not delivered by next week, customer requests a refund of 62,90 €. Internal note: Monitor carrier response and prepare refund process if needed.
